title: Pre-migration snapshot: capture current role assignments and permission matrix
expected: Baseline: 15 legacy roles, per-role permission matrix, and user->role assignment captured on the pre-migration build
actual: Not executable: staging is already on the post-migration Custom-Roles build; no pre-migration build/legacy roles page exists and no baseline artifacts were captured before migration. Observable now: 11 system roles present, all default=true.
reason: Blocked: requires the pre-migration build to export the 15-legacy-role baseline; migration already completed on this tenant. No legacy-roles page / baseline available this session.

title: Migration completes without data loss: user accounts, assignments, custom data preserved
expected: User count matches baseline; spot-checked records identical; exactly 11 system roles; 0 custom roles immediately post-migration
actual: Cannot compare to a pre-migration baseline (none captured). Exactly 11 system roles ARE present (Admin, Office, Time Clock, Service Manager, Service Advisor, Foreman, Technician, Parts Manager, Parts Tech, Senior Service Advisor, Sales Representative), all default=true. However 'custom roles = 0 immediately post-migration' is not verifiable: tenant now has ~57 custom roles created by testers over time.
reason: Blocked: core no-data-loss assertion needs the pre-migration baseline (user counts + spot-check records) which does not exist; post-migration custom-role-count=0 window has long passed. Only the 11-system-role presence is observable (confirmed).

title: Legacy 'Owner' users land on system 'Administrator' role (Owner role consolidated into Admin per spec 6/10)
expected: A legacy-Owner user now shows role Administrator; Admin row lock+eye-only; all permissions ON
actual: Legacy 'Owner' role and its users are not present on staging (Owner already consolidated). Cannot locate a user previously on legacy Owner. Observable: system 'Admin' role exists (default=true, deletable=false, usersCount=93) with full 41 perms = every CRUD area V/E/D, all page toggles, all 6 settings, all cross toggles ON. NOTE: EXP expects Admin non-editable (lock+eye-only) but staging shows Admin editable=true (pencil present; toggles disabled + 'Full administrative access' banner).
reason: Blocked: references specific legacy Owner data not present on staging; cannot trace a legacy-Owner user to Administrator. Admin full-permission set is confirmed but the legacy-mapping assertion is unverifiable.

title: Legacy 'Admin' / 'Administrator' users land on system 'Administrator' role (non-editable)
expected: Administrator row shows lock icon and ONLY the eye icon (non-editable); perms match documented Administrator set
actual: System 'Admin' role present: default=true, deletable=false, usersCount=93 (legacy Admin users retained), full 41 perms (all ON). BUT EXP Step4 (lock icon + eye-only, non-editable) does NOT hold: API reports editable=true and the Roles list shows a pencil (edit) affordance for Admin; the editor opens but all toggles are disabled with a 'Full administrative access' banner (per case 26312).
reason: Failed — stale case, behavior OK: Admin permission migration is correct (all 41 perms, 93 users retained) and Admin is effectively non-editable (toggles disabled + banner), but the specific 'lock icon + eye-only' UI expectation is not met on staging (Admin is editable=true with a pencil). Not logged to TestRail.

title: Legacy 'Time Clock' users land on system 'Time Clock User' role (renamed; non-editable)
expected: Role displays as 'Time Clock User' (NOT 'Time Clock'); row lock+eye-only; user can only clock in/out
actual: System role is non-editable (editable=false, deletable=false, lock+eye-only per 26314) and clock-oriented, usersCount=14. BUT the migration RENAME to 'Time Clock User' is NOT applied: both the Roles list UI and GET /api/roles both show the name as 'Time Clock' (desc 'Clock in/out only'). Also the role carries 3 read perms (workOrdersView, scheduleView, timesheetsView), granting read-only Work Orders access (VIU-33) rather than pure clock-only.
reason: Failed: EXP Step2 requires the label 'Time Clock User' but staging shows 'Time Clock' (migration rename not written). Non-editability is correct but the case's specific rename assertion fails. Not logged to TestRail.
